messages:
evan: short thread: clarify sidecar fallback semantics for private tenants. we need to be explicit before rollout.
rhea: agreed. what are the allowed transitions? private -> hosted should be opt-in only. dedicated -> hosted maybe allowed for burst with billing tag.
omar: propose small matrix: private: default deny, opt-in allows local-cache or explicit hosted-fallback; dedicated: default allow-burst with billing; hosted: always allowed.
lyn: add constraint: any cross-zone hop must carry signed provenance + policy_version header. no provenance -> reject. this prevents silent mis-billing.
evans: also require CP-signed policy blob cached by sidecar; sidecar enforces fallback rules even when CP unreachable. policy-blo bs must include grace_modes and key IDs.
rhea: tests: 1) reject missing sig, 2) ensure local-cache serves when CP down and tenant opted in, 3) hosted fallback emits fallback_event to audit sink.
policy-bot: [note] policy-service v2 published; sidecars will fetch policy blobs on interval.
omar: action items: rhea -> draft policy blob spec; lyn -> provenance header spec; evan -> rollout plan + ff gating.
rhea: let's keep the RFC small and include minimal sequence diagrams. thanks.
